title: Localized groundwater-response replay of the frozen G10 B4 mixed-regime path
question: Does the frozen B4/GW_MIXED P1/P4 path converge when the globalization merit/reference uses a prospectively frozen local MODFLOW response that resolves the 1e-15 coupling scale, while all SWAP, E3, starts and line-search rules remain unchanged?

local_response_contract.selection_rationale: Use the largest nested G10A neighborhood. It is fixed before G10B and its observed fit error 3.21e-19 m/s is far below the unchanged G10 1e-15 residual scale.
local_response_contract.fit: ordinary affine least-squares q_gw(H)=aH+b over all 13 fixed points

reference_root.method: Use the unchanged G10 fixed SWAP head scan and the G10B local q_gw(H) fit; select the first adjacent status-0 sign-changing interval and bisect with the unchanged real-SWAP trial residual.
reference_root.independent_check: Compare the resulting local-affine root head with the G10A direct coupled root -0.7149997332230622 m.

policies.P1_E3: Unchanged G09D E3 physical Newton using the local GW response only for merit/reference evaluation.
policies.P4_E3: Same E3 proposal and unchanged factor-1/2 line search with residual non-increase and max 12 contractions; local GW response replaces only the broad G10 merit/reference oracle.

gates: Carrier href/u/qbot exactly reproduces B4 authority within 1e-14.
All 13 local constant-flux MODFLOW probes execute from fresh accepted groundwater origin.
Local affine response fit error <=1e-16 m/s and slope >0.
A local-affine coupled reference root exists inside the unchanged G10 fixed scan and lies within 5e-10 m of the G10A direct coupled root.
P4-E3 converges from both frozen G10 starts within 12 outer iterations.
Every SWAP diagnostic candidate is discarded and accepted revision/time/ledger remain unchanged.
interpretation_rules: G10 remains falsified; G10B is a new local-merit qualification.
P4 zero contractions is allowed and means only that the corrected merit accepts the physical Newton proposal; it does not qualify safeguard recovery.
If P4 still fails under the local response, the failure is no longer attributable to the broad G10 affine oracle alone.
This work unit qualifies only the B4/GW_MIXED research path; no universal groundwater-response contract is claimed.
No production HCOF/RHS or coupling source change.
